name: forge (Rust on wgpu)
describe: A Rust core on wgpu, shipped as one prebuilt, hash-pinned wasm per release in two builds (WebGPU, WebGL2), with a JavaScript layer that joins the shared system. First-person and close-camera action with weight; live co-op.
for: first-person action with weight: shooters, wave nights, roguelite runs, arena fights; co-op for 1-4 friends who see each other
says: plays on phones and desktops: WebGPU where the browser has it, else its WebGL2 build; co-op for 1 to 4; first person only; not yet tried in an in-app browser

evidence.what: a gaslit-street wave game passes verify --release (all gates)
the creator played a forge game: "honestly not bad at all in terms of quality, smoothness, and gameplay"
the minimal example ruin-hold: see its example.json verified

state.note: opened to pitches by the creator on 2026-10-13: "We can open forge and vista."

evidence.what: the creator played forge games on their desktop
the creator played a forge game on their phone

phone.note: the creator's phone, browser not recorded; the creator found the HUD too large there; in-app browsers untested

limits.firstLoad: the wasm core (a few MB) and its models

play.rules: rules.js: commands in, events out (the core simulates); health, loot, pickup and waves run on forge (components/<id>/impl/forge, kit/mechanics.js), each with a two-player fixture (tools/fixture.mjs); the others keep their params for the rules
play.loops: the shared session's round and endless flows over the core's waves

worlds.describe: a torch-lit stone room of KayKit pieces (CC0)
a moonlit ruined courtyard generated from world.seed
a gaslit old-town street opening into a square, generated from world.seed

slots.how: models, textures and table values are slots; coverage from the core's instance report; roles this kit does not ship are drawn by free (CC0) stand-ins (tools/stand-ins.mjs)

multiplayer.how: live co-op 1-4: the host's core owns the world and replays each friend's inputs; Go live and voice

hostBridge.how: menu, HUD, wallet and economy buttons (measure 22 on forge in real time)
